assumptions: Every test uses the same trading days and S&P 500 closing prices. Dividends are not counted.
A rule that is out of the market earns nothing while it waits. No interest on cash.
Trades happen at the close on the day the signal appears; the gain or loss starts the next day.
No trading costs or taxes. Rules that trade often look better here than they would in real life.
BATS was designed and tuned by us on this same history, so it has a home-field advantage. CNN's index was not tuned by us.

strategies.name: Buy_and_Hold
strategies.description: Baseline. Always invested in the S&P 500. Sets the bar every other rule has to clear.
strategies.label: Buy and hold

strategies.name: Trend_Only
strategies.description: Invested when the S&P 500 is above its 200-day average, out otherwise. Uses neither gauge.
strategies.label: Trend only (200-day average)

strategies.name: CNN_Fear_to_Greed
strategies.description: Buy when CNN is under 25 (Extreme Fear), hold until it reaches 75 (Extreme Greed).
strategies.label: CNN: buy Extreme Fear, sell Extreme Greed

strategies.name: BATS_Oversold_to_Extended
strategies.description: Buy when BATS is under 32 (Oversold), hold until it reaches 72 (Extended).
strategies.label: BATS: buy Oversold, sell Extended

strategies.name: CNN_Lowest10pct
strategies.description: Equal pickiness: buy when CNN is 19.0 or lower (its lowest 10% of readings), sell at its middle reading (50.2).
strategies.label: CNN: buy its lowest 10% of readings

strategies.name: BATS_Lowest10pct
strategies.description: Equal pickiness: buy when BATS is 40.4 or lower (its lowest 10% of readings), sell at its middle reading (59.4).
strategies.label: BATS: buy its lowest 10% of readings

strategies.name: CNN_Avoid_ExtremeGreed
strategies.description: Stay invested, sell when CNN reaches 75 (Extreme Greed), buy back when it cools to 55.
strategies.label: CNN: step aside at Extreme Greed

strategies.name: BATS_Avoid_Extended
strategies.description: Stay invested, sell when BATS reaches 72 (Extended), buy back when it cools to 57.
strategies.label: BATS: step aside at Extended

strategies.name: CNN_ExtremeFear_25_55
strategies.description: Earlier exit: buy when CNN is under 25, sell as soon as it reaches 55 (Greed).
strategies.label: CNN: buy Extreme Fear, sell at Greed

strategies.name: BATS_Oversold_32_57
strategies.description: Earlier exit: buy when BATS is under 32, sell as soon as it reaches 57 (Slightly Bullish).
strategies.label: BATS: buy Oversold, sell at Slightly Bullish

strategies.name: BATS_Oversold_32_65
strategies.description: Middle exit: buy when BATS is under 32, sell when it reaches 65 (Bullish).
strategies.label: BATS: buy Oversold, sell at Bullish

strategies.name: CNN_ExtremeFear_20_50
strategies.description: Tighter fear entry: buy when CNN is 20 or lower, sell when it reaches 50.
strategies.label: CNN: buy at 20, sell at 50

strategies.name: CNN_Fear_plus_Trend
strategies.description: Buy when CNN is under 25 AND the S&P 500 is above its 200-day average. Sell at 55 or when the trend breaks.
strategies.label: CNN Extreme Fear, uptrends only

strategies.name: BATS_Low_25_55
strategies.description: Stricter BATS entry: buy when BATS is 25 or lower, sell when it reaches 55.
strategies.label: BATS: buy at 25, sell at 55

strategies.name: BATS_Low_30_60
strategies.description: Buy when BATS is 30 or lower, sell when it reaches 60.
strategies.label: BATS: buy at 30, sell at 60

strategies.name: CNN_AND_BATS_Both_Low
strategies.description: Buy only when CNN is under 25 AND BATS is under 32. Sell when either reaches its exit (55 / 57).
strategies.label: Both gauges in their buy zone

strategies.name: CNN_OR_BATS_Either_Low
strategies.description: Buy when CNN is under 25 OR BATS is under 32. Sell only when both have reached their exits.
strategies.label: Either gauge in its buy zone

strategies.name: MACD_Cross_10bar
strategies.description: The Divergences-page rule on daily bars: buy when the MACD line crosses above its signal after >= 10 closed bars below; sell on the mirror cross after >= 10 bars above. Earlier crosses ignored.
strategies.label: MACD cross, 10-bar minimum

strategies.name: MACD_Cross_NoFilter
strategies.description: Same crossover with no 10-bar minimum: every MACD/signal cross trades. Shows what the filter is worth.
strategies.label: MACD cross, every cross

strategies.name: MACD_Cross_10bar_plus_Trend
strategies.description: MACD 10-bar crossover, but buys only when SPX > 200-day MA and also exits on a trend break.
strategies.label: MACD cross, uptrends only

strategies.name: MACD_Weekly_Cross_10bar
strategies.description: The same 10-bar crossover on weekly bars: decided at each Friday close, held through the following week.
strategies.label: MACD cross, weekly bars

pairs.title: Buy the fear, sell the greed
pairs.blurb: Each gauge's lowest zone in, each gauge's highest zone out. The same idea on both.

pairs.title: Equal pickiness
pairs.blurb: Both gauges fire equally often: buy at the lowest 10% of each one's readings, sell at its middle reading.

pairs.title: Stay invested, step aside when it runs hot
pairs.blurb: The sell-side test: hold stocks, sell when the gauge hits its hot zone, buy back when it cools.
